notes.title: Release Date!
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42120843/4558226b9e4b05412f51bcfd49a1cd61d58ec418.png

Hello!

We are proud to announce that TAPE: Unveil the Memories is coming to Steam and PlayStation on April 14th.

In TAPE, you will play as Iria, a girl who receives a VHS tape from her missing father asking for help. After this, Iria will find herself in the depths of her mind, where she can use her father's old video camera to interact with her memories, rewinding, fast-forwarding and pausing the objects she finds.

Using this time-affecting camera, Iria will be able to traverse her broken memories and uncover the secrets behind the tragic events that led to her father's disappearance.

You can now watch our announcement trailer with lots of new features and add TAPE to your Wishlist.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1910320/TAPE_Unveil_the_Memories/?beta=0
We hope you like it!

From the folks at BlackChiliGoat
